better-alias.options.title: Better Alias
better-alias.options.mode.tooltip.fxaa: FXAA: fastest. Smooths edges in one pass, but softens fine texture detail a little.
better-alias.options.mode.tooltip.smaa: SMAA 1x: follows each edge's shape for a cleaner, sharper result than FXAA. Low cost.
better-alias.options.mode.tooltip.smaa_t: SMAA T2x: SMAA 1x plus a tiny camera shift each frame, blending the last 2 frames. Smoother edges and less shimmer, still sharp. Your hand isn't smoothed.
better-alias.options.mode.tooltip.smaa_4: SMAA 4x (Temporal): like SMAA T2x, but blends 4 frames for 4 samples per pixel. The smoothest SMAA option; fast mobs can look slightly soft. Your hand isn't smoothed.
better-alias.options.mode.tooltip.cmaa2: CMAA2: only fixes clear stair-step edges and leaves text and textures untouched. The sharpest option. Low cost.
better-alias.options.mode.tooltip.taa: TAA: shifts the camera slightly each frame and blends many frames. Smooths everything, including shimmering textures, with sharpening to keep detail. Fast mobs can leave faint trails; your hand isn't smoothed.
better-alias.options.mode.tooltip.ssaa: SSAA: draws the world at a higher resolution and shrinks it down. The cleanest image, but by far the most demanding. Set how far to push it with SSAA Scale.
better-alias.options.mode.tooltip.iris: Pauses while an Iris shader pack is on, unless Keep With Shader Packs is enabled.
better-alias.options.mode.tooltip.iris_t: %s always turns off while an Iris shader pack is on.
better-alias.options.mode.tooltip.iris_s: %s always turns off while an Iris shader pack is on.
better-alias.options.mode.paused: Paused: an Iris shader pack is on. Turn it off, or enable Keep With Shader Packs.
better-alias.options.mode.paused_tempora: Paused: this method can't run with an Iris shader pack.
better-alias.options.cmaa2_quality.toolt: Ultra: even very faint edges; may soften subtle texture detail.
better-alias.options.taa_sharpness.toolt:
How much detail AMD CAS sharpening restores after TAA's blending. 0% is off.

Only used with TAA.
1.25x: about 1.6 samples per pixel. The lightest step; about 1.6x the GPU work.
1.5x: 2.25 samples per pixel. Light; about 2x the GPU work.
1.75x: about 3 samples per pixel. About 3x the GPU work.
2x (recommended): 4 samples per pixel. About 4x the GPU work.
2.5x: about 6 samples per pixel. About 6x the GPU work.
3x: 9 samples per pixel. About 9x the GPU work; for powerful graphics cards.
4x: 16 samples per pixel. About 16x the GPU work; mainly for screenshots.
better-alias.options.render_resolution: Renders at %3$s x %4$s for your %1$s x %2$s window.
better-alias.options.ssaa_scale.limited: Reduced to your graphics card's maximum texture size.
better-alias.options.ssaa_scale.only_ssa: Only used with SSAA. Drops to a smaller scale automatically if video memory runs out.
better-alias.options.rcas_sharpness.tool:
Sharpens the final image with AMD's RCAS (from FSR) to bring back detail lost to anti-aliasing or upscaling, without halos. 0% is off; 25-50% suits most methods. With FSR 1 upscaling this is FSR's own sharpening step.

Not used with TAA or NIS, which have their own sharpening.
better-alias.options.upscaler.tooltip.of: Off: the world renders at your window's full resolution.
better-alias.options.upscaler.tooltip.fs: FSR 1: renders the world at a lower resolution for more FPS, then upscales it with AMD's edge-aware FSR 1. The cleanest result; pair it with RCAS Sharpening (about 25-40%).
better-alias.options.upscaler.tooltip.ni: NIS: renders the world at a lower resolution for more FPS, then upscales and sharpens it with NVIDIA Image Scaling. Crisper than FSR 1 but can ring around hard edges; tune with NIS Sharpness.
better-alias.options.upscaler.tooltip.sh: Works on any graphics card and with every method except SSAA. The anti-aliasing runs before upscaling. The HUD stays at full resolution. Turns off while an Iris shader pack is on.
better-alias.options.render_scale.toolti: How much of your window's resolution the world is rendered at before upscaling. Lower means more FPS but a softer image.
better-alias.options.upscaling.only: Only used when an Upscaler is selected.
better-alias.options.nis_sharpness.toolt:
How strongly NIS sharpens while upscaling. Lower if edges look harsh.

Only used with the NIS upscaler.
better-alias.options.keep_with_shader_pa:
Off (recommended): FXAA, SMAA 1x, CMAA2 and RCAS pause while an Iris shader pack is on.
On: they run on top of the shader pack.
Needs Iris, plus FXAA, SMAA 1x, CMAA2 or RCAS. The other methods and upscaling always turn off with shader packs.
Most shader packs have their own anti-aliasing and sharpening. Stacking another usually looks blurrier or over-sharpened.
better-alias.options.iris_status.not_ins: Iris isn't installed, so this has no effect.
better-alias.options.iris_status.active: Iris: a shader pack is on.
better-alias.options.show_edges.tooltip:
Debug view: dims the image and paints every pixel the current method treats as an edge magenta. Useful for comparing methods and for bug reports. Turns itself off when the game restarts.

Only for FXAA, SMAA 1x and CMAA2.
better-alias.options.performance_readout: Adds a line with the method, the resolution the world is drawn at, and how long Better Alias's own GPU passes take. Off, only on the F3 screen, or always on screen. The same setting appears in F3's debug options.
better-alias.rcas.name: RCAS sharpening
better-alias.toast.shader_pack.title: Better Alias + shader pack
better-alias.toast.shader_pack.message: %s is running on top of your shader pack. Turn off Keep With Shader Packs if it looks blurry.
better-alias.toast.ssaa_memory.title: SSAA: not enough video memory
better-alias.toast.ssaa_memory.none: %s didn't fit at any scale. SSAA is off until you change the setting.
